label: The dinar is reinstated but the payout disappoints
description: A reinstatement of the dinar bringing a wealth transfer, with the warning that the banks sucker punch holders on the spread, that the rate is far below the old three dollar figure people expect, and that someone hoping for twenty million receives something nearer one. Given 6 February 2025.
aliases: sucker punch you when you go to take it to the banks

label: The United States puts a trillion dollars into crypto
description: The US government seen pumping a trillion dollars into cryptocurrency across the presidential term, with Japan, Australia and other nations joining in the same four years. Given 19 January 2025.
aliases: pumping a trillion dollars into crypto

label: He says he was shown Solana at forty dollars
description: A claim that the Lord named Solana to him when it was forty dollars, before the president's coin was launched on that platform and the price reached roughly three hundred. Told 19 January 2025, after both events.
aliases: trump lined his coin up with

label: The founding fathers' covenant, down to threads, is restored by blessing Israel
description: A two-sided covenant made with the founding fathers, America's side worn down to a few threads and open to being cut as a breach of contract, God's side unbroken, and the whole thing pulled strong again as the president allies with Israel, making a three stranded cord.
aliases: covenant that was made with our founding fathers

label: America uses weapons it has never used in battle
description: Weapons the United States has practised with but never used on a foreign adversary, about to be used, alongside a heavy carrier and battleship presence in the Mediterranean as an intimidation. Given 6 February 2025.
aliases: weapons that the United States has never used before

label: Respect for America is restored, a Reagan type and shadow
description: Respect that America is said to have lost over four years coming back so that adversaries take it seriously again, given as a type and shadow of Reagan but stronger, and tied to a single window of four years.
aliases: a type and Shadow of a Ronald Reagan

label: Two New York buildings collapse from the inside out
description: Two large buildings standing alone in New York seen blown from the inside out, glass blasted outward, both falling in a cauliflower of smoke, which he distinguishes explicitly from September 11th and says shuts the economy down. He states he believes he knows which buildings but will not name them.
aliases: these two buildings standing by themselves

label: A mushroom cloud out of New York
description: A huge mushroom cloud seen coming out of New York, which he says he does not understand and keeps separate from the two collapsing buildings shown in the same sitting. Given 18 January 2025.

label: America left with no leadership and uncovered
description: Biden seen in the Oval Office with glazed eyes and seasons passing before him, and America described as having no leadership, its covering pulled back, a sitting duck over which the antichrist agenda is free to hover.
aliases: there was no leadership Over America
it was vulnerable because of no leadership

label: The king of the north and the kings of the east plan against America
description: Heard rather than seen: the king from the north and the kings from the east devising a plan against the United States, with Putin and Xi meeting in Saudi Arabia over BRICS. Given 18 January 2025.
aliases: the king from the North and the Kings from the East
devising a plan against the United States

label: The window for the harvest is closing
description: A stated word that there is a window right now to bring in as many as possible and that the window is going to close, given as the reason for the language channels and for one last call.
aliases: the window's coming the window is going to close

label: Communist parties fall under American leadership
description: A leadership coming out of the American president that causes the communist parties to fall, prayed alongside a harvest of souls across Asia and a separation named over Xi Jinping.
aliases: cause the communistic parties to come to fall

label: Macron, Schwab and another man will not be here much longer
description: Three named figures, the French president, Klaus Schwab and one more he does not name, said not to be here much longer, while the antichrist spirit remains and a greater wave of darkness follows. Given 21 January 2025.
aliases: they will not be here much longer

label: There is a rat within America
description: A repeated warning that there is a rat, or rats, inside America, given alongside the phrase Red Dawn and an instruction to watch Cuba, with the detail withheld because he says he cannot go into it.
